smallest_supported_claim: The distinct source- and executable-bound nighttime account completed one ordinary player-selected inventory visit and six native movement actions, then reached the main menu through native Save and Quit and exited through native quit confirmation. It is a partial night-travel account only: it does not establish a lit-base or late-rider outcome.
causal_account: The fresh account was separately bound to the native-saved night fixture. It accepted a World inventory action and then native west/north movement actions selected from the current World surface; no debug or injected action was used. At the honest boundary it accepted native Save and Quit and its confirmation, reached the native main menu, and accepted native application quit confirmation. The available route did not present a player-legible lit-base or late-rider outcome, so neither is claimed.
